environment.notes: Fresh sequential processes, three repeats, alternating source order. Other development services may be active; no CPU affinity. Tree measurements exclude setup; snapshot measurements use the official nengi-buffers backend and controlled clock.

sources.note: Core baseline includes prior uncommitted performance and other work. The production-source difference in this comparison is LocalState.addChild invalidation starting at the newly attached child instead of its parent.
sources.loamNote: The pinned package and server publisher are unchanged for reader before/after comparisons. The core attachment fix is measured separately; it is not installed in Loam.

loam.scope: Synthetic construction/grid records, NOT physical vehicles of these sizes. Identical immutable game states; actual binary nengi snapshots, two subscribers, complete Loam history reconstruction. Four numeric cell edits per publication; runs edit 64 adjacent cells; structural case inserts/removes 32 cells every 15 publications. Balanced trial order after exact warm validation. Dirty variant additionally applies known edit operations inside server timing; scan variants discover changes from complete states. No physics/replay/rendering/socket framing or GC claims. Bootstrap measured separately.
loam.repeats: Eight balanced orders of the four modes per workload, all before runs then all after runs. Absolute timings are not host-isolated.

validation.loamBenchmark: Exact reconstruction before timing each mode; all bootstrap and update byte counts match before/after
validation.caveats: No FPS, WAN capacity, or allocation/GC improvement claimed from these timings.
